summary: Frontend-only UI test of the PARAS REWARD dashboard reskin (Elite user 9970100782 -> uid 76b75808, plus Explorer user 9000006864) at mobile 430x900 and desktop 1920x800. Every dashboard item in the brief passed: wallet card, mining widget, collect eligibility, start/cooldown button, Pay to Partner Store card, Redeem Limit card visible/hidden by plan, Quick Recharge, Profile Completion, bottom nav, and /bank-redeem. No console errors. A spot check of other pages found unreadable dark-on-dark text on the /profile hero and on /referrals (Community Growth). This comes from the global .text-white override.

minor.issue: Login for user 8888800001 (uid pstore-100001, a seeded partner-store user) returns 'Login service temporarily unavailable'. Backend log: "[LOGIN DEBUG] User lookup ERROR ... 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'lower'". A field on that user record is probably None. Outside this task's scope; I used a different Explorer user.

integration_issues.flow: Dashboard Redeem Limit card vs Recharge/Bank Redeem
integration_issues.issue: For the Elite user, the dashboard card (legacy GET /api/user/{uid}/redeem-limit) shows TOTAL 0.00 PRC, USED - 1,33,117.78 PRC, REMAINING 0 PRC, 0.00% Unlocked. On the same page, Quick Recharge (GET /api/redemption-limit/status) shows 'Remaining Redeem Limit: 8,610 PRC', and /bank-redeem shows 8,610 PRC. This follows the user's choice to keep the legacy API, but users see contradictory numbers on one screen. Flag it to the user.

issues: The user name (h-tag with class text-white) renders rgb(38,50,56) on a dark navy gradient (#1a1a2e -> #0f0f23), so it is almost invisible. Cause: global .text-white -> #263238 !important in index.css. Fix: add the pr-dark-scope class to that hero container.

The page background is dark, but 'Level Progression', the stat numbers (Direct Members / Community Size = 3), the header title and the locked L4-L10 tiles render dark grey/ink on near-black, which is very low contrast. Same root cause (text-white and text-gray-400 remapped for light theme). Fix: wrap the page root in pr-dark-scope or move the page to the light palette.

Probably pre-existing; ParasMall files were not touched. .mall-root is position:fixed with z-index 9999 and covers the bottom nav (by design, there is a back button). The hero (mall-hero-grid, absolute) overlaps the product card and the 'Washing Machine' text overlaps the PARAS MALL title at 430px width.
The 'Service Fee Pending' banner sits over the app header, so the logo, language and bell row is hidden and a blank strip shows below the banner.
The persistent 'complete your profile' toast and the LIVE ticker stack above the bottom nav and cover about 120px of content on mobile.

verified_passing: Desktop 1920: dashboard-root is 576px wide and centered (left 672). Ancestor background is Ivory rgb(255,249,232). Mobile layout is fine.

Wallet card is charcoal. PRC balance is blue (#3D82E0), 20261.97, which matches GET /api/users/{uid} prc_balance 20261.972162. Plan badge is gold #D6A638. Card holder and reward rate are readable (green #4CC38A).
Timer cells are white with dark numerals #263238. Session earnings card is pale blue #EDF4FF. Earnings rose from 346.05 to 346.14 over 10s. PRC/SEC, PRC/HOUR and the progress bar are visible.
Elite user: collect-rewards-btn is enabled and blue rgb(36,107,206) ('Collect Rewards (346.05 PRC)'). Not clicked.

Explorer user: upgrade-to-collect-box is shown. collect-disabled-btn is disabled, grey #E9ECF1, dashed border, cursor not-allowed, and Playwright confirms it cannot be clicked. No collect-rewards-btn is shown.
start-mining-btn: idle state is blue with white text. Cooldown state (simulated through a mocked mining/status start_cooldown_seconds) is grey, dashed and disabled, labelled 'Start Session in 40s'.
dashboard-pay-partner-store-btn is pale blue with a green left border and navigates to /pay-partner-store.

Redeem Limit card shows for the Elite user and is hidden for the Explorer user. Values match the legacy API: total_limit 0, total_redeemed 133117.78 shown as '- 1,33,117.78 PRC' (a display prefix only), effective_available 0.

Recharge card is charcoal. Inputs show light text (#F3F5F8) and placeholders #8E99A8. The active toggle (Mobile or DTH) turns blue. Submit is dashed grey and disabled until the form is valid, then blue. Typing 600 in amount is capped at 60. A 5-digit number shows the toast 'Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number' and sends no recharge POST. recharge-limit-remaining is visible.
Profile completion card is pale blue, the ring gradient goes #075C3B -> #D6A638, the percent is green, and Complete goes to /profile?edit=true.

Bottom nav is charcoal rgb(32,37,45). The active label is gold and inactive labels are #8A94A3. nav-home, nav-referrals, nav-mall, nav-community and nav-profile reach /dashboard, /referrals, /mall, /community and /profile (when starting from a non-mall page).
/bank-redeem shows the progressive limit card (progressive-total-limit 8,610 PRC) and bank-redeem-amount-chips.
action_items: Add the pr-dark-scope class (or switch to light surfaces) on the /profile hero card and the /referrals Community Growth page; text there is currently dark-on-dark.
Optional, needs the user's OK: the dashboard Redeem Limit card (legacy API: 0 remaining) contradicts the Recharge/Bank Redeem remaining (8,610 PRC) for the same user.
Optional: stop the Service Fee banner from hiding the header row on the dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: index.css global remaps (.text-white -> #263238 !important, .text-gray-400 -> #4B5563) make text unreadable on any dark container that lacks pr-dark-scope. Audit the remaining dark gradient containers (Profile hero, Referrals, the Mall dark cards).
DashboardModern Redeem card: `effective_available || available || 0` falls back to `available` when effective_available is a legitimate 0. Use ?? instead.
Redeem card visibility requires stats.subscriptionPlan to be truthy. If the plan is missing or empty, the card is hidden for paid users too.
RechargeCard isFormValid does not check for a 10-digit mobile number, so the button turns blue for 5 digits and the error only appears as a toast on click. Consider inline validation.
DashboardModern.js (1168 lines) is over the 700-line guideline; RechargeCard.js is 719.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested dashboard checks; 2 regression spot-check pages have contrast issues

seed_data_creation: Set PIN 900006 on Explorer preview user edc80e3f-22ff-469b-b3cf-f7f0212e605b (mobile 9000006864) and started a mining session for it. Also overwrote the PIN hash of pstore-100001 (8888800001) with 888801 before finding that its login fails for an unrelated reason; its original hash is gone.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login is 2-step: login-identifier-input -> login-submit-btn -> type the PIN into [data-testid^=login-pin]; it auto-submits. /mall is a fixed z-9999 overlay, so bottom-nav clicks from /mall are blocked by design. Cooldown state can be simulated by routing **/api/mining/status/** and setting start_cooldown_seconds. Do not click collect for the Elite user (forced ad flow).
